limitations: Population-level semiparametric identification only. Independence, a common continuous proportional-hazards baseline, and strictly positive multipliers are required. Numerical inversion can be ill-conditioned for nearly equal hazards. The complete Pledger-Proschan (1971) chapter was not available for theorem-by-theorem inspection and remains a residual originality risk.
provenance: An exact elimination of the unknown common proportional-hazards baseline reduces the first two failure-time marginals to a uniquely identifiable finite exponential sum.
record_title: First two unlabeled failure marginals identify heterogeneous proportional hazards
